items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: But Harold and Melvin and Tammy and, uh, John Boudreaux stayed out.

ctx.x: So, I stayed out there as long as I could. When my sister died I came back home. But Harold and Melvin and Tammy and, uh, John Boudreaux stayed out. Uh-huh. And the only one out there now is, uh, John Boudreaux and, uh, Tammy Lynn.
Yeah. Um, had, had you remarried by this time?
